name: ai-factory-supervision
description: Local React supervision UI and Node backend for AI Factory

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ai-factory/contracts && npm run build --workspace ai-factory-server && npm run build --workspace ai-factory-ui
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test server/dist/tests/*.test.js ui/dist/tests/*.test.js
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start --workspace ai-factory-server
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --workspace ai-factory-server
